_comment: Venue Opta-ID -> IANA timezone. HUMAN-MAINTAINED. Never auto-generated.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: a UID contains the venue-LOCAL match date. To get a
local date from the UTC kickoff we need the venue's timezone. Guessing it
(e.g. 'US venue => Eastern') would silently produce a wrong local date for
a night game and therefore a wrong, unstable UID -- which duplicates the
event for every subscriber. So: no timezone here => the fixture is
QUARANTINED (reported loudly, kept out of the .ics) rather than guessed.
CHANGING A tz VALUE CHANGES UIDs. test_refresh.py pins the UIDs of every
venue below; edit a tz and the test suite fails on purpose.
'name' and 'location' are documentation only -- the Opta id is the key,
because stadium names get resold (Busch -> Energizer Park) but ids do not.

7paouifzs4wopmnhclh8nmitr.name: State Farm Stadium
7paouifzs4wopmnhclh8nmitr.note: Arizona does not observe DST -- America/Phoenix is UTC-7 year round. This is exactly why venue tz is a lookup and not 'US = Eastern'.
